name: io.github.KilaWattCloud/kilawatt-mcp-server
description: Kilawatt Cloud MCP server: request GPU compute with account or x402 payments.

environmentVariables.description: Your API key for the service
environmentVariables.name: KILAWATT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional site root for the discovery and resume tools
environmentVariables.name: KILAWATT_SITE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Wallet private key for paying for x402 jobs
environmentVariables.name: KILAWATT_X402_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Maximum USD spend per x402 job (default 0.25)
environmentVariables.name: KILAWATT_X402_MAX_USD_PER_JOB

environmentVariables.description: Maximum USD spend per server session (default 1.00)
environmentVariables.name: KILAWATT_X402_MAX_USD_PER_SESSION
